plainText:
Miyako Itō (Japanese: 伊東みやこ Itō Miyako ) is a Japanese voice actress for . She is also credited as Momoko Momoi.

==Biography==
Itō was born on February 23, 1969, in , . She joined the during and voiced a number of characters, both human and Pokémon. Itō is currently affiliated with the talent agency Ken Production.
